data.headline: Global R&D, Engineering & AI Strategy Leader | Engineering Transformation | Enterprise AI | Product Innovation | Organizational Leadership
data.about: Executive Summary: Global R&D, Engineering & AI executive with 27+ years of experience leading enterprise product engineering, organizational transformation, and technology strategy across global healthcare and technology organizations. Proven track record of aligning business strategy with engineering, AI, and innovation to accelerate growth, enhance customer value, and deliver sustainable business outcomes.Executive Vision:-   Transform global R&D organizations into strategic business enablers through technology, AI, innovation, and engineering excellence.-   Build world-class engineering organizations that accelerate innovation, operational excellence, and customer value.-   Develop future-ready leaders and engineering ecosystems that enable sustainable business growth and organizational excellence.

description.text:
Lead Innovation Outcomes & Analytics org at Philips, to ensure right innovations identified, ranked and prioritized with full transparency on innovation investments. Leverage AI/deep learning to define better scenarios and ways to use budget, resources and technology to get to a better return on investment and customer value. 
Key responsibilities include,
- Drive prioritization of Innovation investment to deliver sooner, safer and superior solutions.
- Drive Philips innovation strategy of delivering fewer, better and bigger products and solution to market by incorporating market trends / opportunities, competition, returns, customer delights and product quality and patient safety needs.
- Build and lead team of data scientist, analytics, AI engineers and architects to drive digital transformation.
- Challenge the current allocations and raise the bar, deliver quality data, continuous improvement and let businesses and functions understand how this can be used in the decision-making process.
- Work with all stakeholders to deliver innovation outcomes through intelligent insights and prescriptive analytics.

Led software engineering teams in “Clinically driven revenue cycle management” business group. Directly managing 70+ agile teams that are part of solutions covering, Front Office, Analytics, Middle Office, Back Office, Enabling Technologies and Platform capabilities. 
Key responsibilities include,
-  Strategic vision and thought leadership to drive technology strategies, architecture and functional advancement.
-  Guide and mentor executives on technology transformation and PLM to meet market expectations.
-  Interact with various business stakeholders, senior leadership to define long-term & short-term business objectives.
-  Develop technical and technology strategies that will lower TCO and generate quicker ROI.
-  Drive innovation and execution of functional and technical ideas towards business growth and market value.
-  Be a champion to drive agile transformation by establishing right structure, culture, mindset, process and framework.
-  Product modernization, development and delivery as per roadmap, client commitments and market expectations.
-  Innovative approaches to accelerate hiring & on-boarding capacity growth towards faster productivity & accountability

Built an led engineering R&D teams spreading across various EMR products that include Revenue Cycle Management, Population Health, mPages, Administratif, Discovere, FetaLink, Apache/Critical Care Dev. Few critical responsibility that include,
-   Thought Leadership on new innovations & product development & maintenance and transitioning team from execution to leadership mindset.
-   Establishing entire Population Health business unit in India from scratch.
-   Continuous process improvements with focus on delivery Process Excellence.
-   Product development – Own and build product lines and new features (NPIs)
-   Collaborate and drive global operating model with goal to transition product Engineering and delivery ownership responsibilities from the US to India.
-   Planning and proactive People Management to establish right Engineering culture across organization at multiple locations.
-   Building and Enhancing Competencies for current & future opportunities to drive Product strategy as per long term and short term vision.
-   Complete ownership of Product quality and security to delivery high quality software.
